inputs.name: Static RAM root with console and Wi-Fi tools

scenario: On one operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample, boot the ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT_WIFI kernel in normal multiuser RAM mode and attempt the selected WPA3/SAE profile with PMF required.
expected: The selected BSS passes vendor compatibility checks, SAE completes, association uses PMF, and the interface obtains an IP address for data exchange.
observed: One continuous candidate/begin/restored/terminal diagnostic cycle completed with each count equal to 1; the vendor DEBUG-enable and warning-restore calls each returned 0. The vendor emitted `wifi:receive encrypted ap, but password is empty and no DPP credentials` for both encrypted BSS candidates. Vendor Wi-Fi auth mode was WIFI_AUTH_WPA3_PSK (6), PMF capable and required were 1, and PWE configuration input was 0. The vendor reported disconnect reason 210 NO_AP_FOUND_W_COMPATIBLE_SECURITY, which the kernel also decoded. The rejection occurred before SAE: no SAE callbacks, completed association, IP address, or data exchange followed.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and RAM-only trial; this does not establish another board revision or persistent installation.
The RAM root is identified by role only; its private configuration is not part of this shared record.
Elapsed time is from bootm to the terminal diagnostic marker. The private capture and its path are not part of this shared record.
The rejection occurred before SAE; this result does not establish over-the-air SAE, completed WPA3/PMF association, IPv4, or data exchange.
WPA2-only authentication, DHCP/DNS, reconnect, roaming and sustained transfer remain unaccepted.
